description: Legality invariants governing lawful curvature, lawful transitions, lawful collapse, and lawful recovery across DSLO substrates.

curvature_bound.definition: Curvature must remain within lawful bounds defined by DSLO geometry.

continuity_requirement.definition: Curvature transitions must maintain lawful continuity except at defined collapse thresholds.

threshold_legality.definition: Collapse thresholds must be lawful, stable, and substrate-consistent.

post_collapse_legality.definition: Recovery behavior must obey lawful curvature and return trajectories.

cross_surface_consistency.definition: Legality invariants must hold uniformly across biological, cultural, abstract, physical, and machine-facing surfaces.

notes.lawfulness: Legality invariants form the substrate-level rules that govern all DSLO geometry and transitions.
notes.integration: Legality invariants bind directly to geometry primitives, transitions, surfaces, and examples within the v0.7 release cluster.
notes.cross_domain: Legality invariants apply uniformly across biological, cultural, abstract, physical, and machine-facing substrates.
